notes: FPS Boost mod 1.0.16 fixes the two dips from the FPS test V2: Explosion Debris Cap stops huge TNT chains (5x5) from spawning hundreds of falling-block entities (each ticked + rendered) — the 6 FPS dip — while blocks are still destroyed; Flat GUI Background skips the full-screen Gaussian blur behind translucent screens (inventory) — the 29 FPS dip — with both as live toggles in the in-game menu (K). Shader browsing now shows a per-pack hardware-fit badge (Apto para tu PC / Limitado / No apto — install at your own risk) based on the real Shader Guard assessment.
